pipeline.fact: 10% critical attempt, 1.5x critical modifier, random variance ±4 around base (VARIANCE_DAMAGE=8), subtract defense, minimum 1; modifiers can also apply in recibirAtaque
creates projectile using ProjectileManager and subscribes to landed for doProjectileDamage
checks projectile target, whether target is alive and impact displacement is within blast radius, then calls target.recibirAtaque
apply damage to internal iHealth, optionally accumulate displayed number, nearDeath signal crossing below 10%, updateVida, die if <=0; damageDone signal dispatched
HealthBar.set(iHealth); display if iHealth<maxLife and >0 and not dead when displayBarraVida is enabled
draws grey background and colored rectangle proportional to currentValue/maxValue, black borders and 4-pixel divisions
sets bDead and handles unit kill/salvage/rewards through game-specific branches
